# The Industrial Scribe

> Frameworks and AI prompts for office staff in Southeast Asian manufacturing: planners, QC executives, purchasing and business-development coordinators. Written by Ah Hock, a pen name, from inside a real Malaysian manufacturing office. For office staff, never for programmers.

Ah Hock publishes only what he has run on real work, uses real numbers, and never names a customer. There is no single standard method in manufacturing: each piece starts by diagnosing the nature of the business, then customises the workflow.

## Start here
- [Home: the solutions](https://theindustrialscribe.com/): What TIS is (agentic AI in manufacturing: how Ah Hock makes your workday smarter. AI drafts, you decide) and the solutions, each sold on its own, pay once: Agentic AI: Visualize to Persuade (USD 9.99), The Waste Hunt (USD 3.99), Workflow Swimlanes (USD 0.99), Agentic AI: Email Assistant (USD 9.99), and two real case-study PDFs (USD 18.99 each). Plus the two real case studies in full, how it works, and the FAQ.
- [The Waste Hunt](https://theindustrialscribe.com/waste-hunt.html): Built on the lean methods factories already trust. An AI interview, about 30 minutes, on one task you redo every week: your business nature, the task step by step, the waste map (the lean 8 wastes, with hours per month), a 5S check of the files and reports behind it (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain, scored out of 25), what to cut first, what to automate and how far, and a build guide that keeps it lean. Paste box for any AI chat (free plans included) or a Claude Code skill (needs Claude Pro). USD 3.99 once. Office workflows only; hours saved are an estimate until timed.
- [Agentic AI: Visualize to Persuade](https://theindustrialscribe.com/okay-noted.html): It finds who decides, works out the numbers, builds the deck, checks its own work, then plays your boss so you can practise. Works as a full AI agent in Claude Code. Works as a step-by-step AI guide in any free chat. It starts with who is watching and what they must decide, then what to show. Proposals, investment plans and business plans that management says yes to, plus the slides and so-what dashboards that back them up. It maps who decides, does payback, return and cost-of-waiting maths from your numbers, answers the six approver questions, builds options with a stop point, prepares the five hardest questions, writes the memo or deck, and rehearses by playing your GM. Nine ready layouts for factory asks, a 22-point pre-ship check. Paste box for any AI chat or a Claude Code skill. USD 9.99 once. It uses only your numbers and cannot make a bad idea good.
- [Agentic AI: Email Assistant](https://theindustrialscribe.com/email-reply.html): It reads the thread, remembers every customer, drafts the reply and tracks what you still owe. You press send. Works as a full AI agent in Claude Code. Works as a step-by-step AI guide in any free chat. Paste the whole customer email chain and get the catch-up (who, what was promised, what is overdue, what they ask now), a warning if the request goes against your own rules or a past decision, one recommended position, and a reply in your language and tone with every date and number checked against the thread; it learns your style from a few sent emails, keeps a card per customer, keeps your edits, never sends. Paste box for any AI chat or a Claude Code skill. USD 9.99 once. Pairs with the email case study.
- [Workflow Swimlanes](https://theindustrialscribe.com/swimlanes.html): A Claude Code skill that draws how your automation should run (lanes: you, the model, scripts) and rebuilds what actually ran from the session logs on your own computer. Needs Claude Pro and Python 3. USD 0.99 once.
- Real case studies (PDF, USD 18.99 each, on the homepage): "How I Stopped Losing Promises in Email Threads: The Reply Is Drafted Before I Open the Email" (28 pages, the AI files every email into a case, remembers what was promised and drafts the reply, real numbers from one user over seven weeks) and "Building So-What Reports: Every Number Says What to Do Next" (23 pages, decks and dashboards built on 856,850 real operations; time saved and decisions changed were never tracked). Both in the format of Anthropic's "Building Effective AI Agents" guide, anonymised.
- The Build Your AI Back-Office kit is no longer sold (withdrawn November 2026). Past buyers keep their download page and free updates.
- [About Ah Hock](https://theindustrialscribe.com/about.html): Who writes this and the rules he writes by
- [The Insider Test (free)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/insider-test.html): 30-question test on how you work in a factory office and how you use AI; gives your type and an AI direction for your job
- [The Pre-Ship Checklist (free)](https://theindustrialscribe.com/free-checklist.html): Free 10-point checklist to run before any deck goes to a boss or a customer

## Answers
- [How to sell AI automation services to small factories](https://theindustrialscribe.com/sell-ai-automation-to-small-factories.html): The buyer's side, from an office worker in a factory in the semiconductor industry. Sell one finished document, not "AI"; run a fixed-price two-week pilot on one hated weekly task and measure before and after; get written permission before any factory file leaves; a human approves every draft. Includes a service ladder, RM price ranges labelled as opinion, the objections a factory raises, and what never to promise.

## Free tools
- [Weekly WIP Status Report](https://theindustrialscribe.com/skill-wip-status-report.html): A copy-paste AI skill that teaches ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to produce a Monday-ready Weekly WIP Status Report from raw job data.
